source.title: Neighbours douse grass fire - Salt Spring Island news

entities.name: Bruce Cameron
entities.description: Co‑owner of the property where the fire started.
entities.quote: Our neighbours are our heroes," said Susan Lundy, who, with her husband Bruce Cameron, owns the property where the fire started.

entities.name: Susan Lundy
entities.description: Co‑owner of the property where the fire started and praised the neighbours.
entities.quote: Our neighbours are our heroes," said Susan Lundy, who, with her husband Bruce Cameron, owns the property where the fire started.

entities.name: Dave McColl
entities.description: Neighbourhood resident who grabbed a fire extinguisher and helped fight the fire.
entities.quote: "I jumped up and grabbed the fire extinguisher out of the closet, got shoes on and ran down our driveway," said neighbourhood resident Dave McColl.

entities.name: Jen
entities.description: Partner of Dave McColl who brought a garden hose to soak the fire.
entities.quote: "...and then Jen brought the hose down from the garden and we started soaking everything."

entities.name: BC Hydro
entities.description: Utility company that experienced a brief island‑wide power outage and sent crews to the scene.
entities.quote: BC Hydro said the single event set off a widespread — if, for most customers, brief — loss of power, affecting more than 950 customers across the island.

entities.name: Salt Spring Island Fire Rescue
entities.description: Agency that lowered the local fire‑hazard level to low.
entities.quote: At press time Monday, July 27, rain and cooling temperatures had allowed Salt Spring Island Fire Rescue to reduce their local fire hazard level to "low".

entities.name: Cusheon Lake Road
entities.description: The 600 block where the fire ignited.
entities.quote: It took just moments for the fire to start after wind caused a large limb to fall and hit power lines just before 11 a.m. Thursday, July 23 in the 600 block of Cusheon Lake Road.

entities.name: Cusheon Lake neighbourhood
entities.description: Residential area where power was restored after the outage.
entities.quote: full service was restored for everyone — including the Cusheon Lake neighbourhood — just after noon

entities.name: Salt Spring Island
entities.description: Island in British Columbia where the incident occurred.
entities.quote: Quick hose work by neighbours kept a fire on Salt Spring from spreading...

source.title: Fire trustees surprised by Fulford pickleball project - Salt Spring Island news

entities.name: Dan Ovington
entities.description: Senior Capital Regional District manager who quipped about island park planning.
entities.quote: Two summers ago, Salt Spring’s senior CRD manager Dan Ovington quipped that island park planning was a bit like “being given a four-seater car and then asked to put six people in it”.

entities.name: Local Community Commission
entities.description: Local governing body that approved the pickleball project charter.
entities.quote: Local Community Commission’s (LCC) unanimous motion last month approving a project charter that envisions as many as eight new courts in the bucolic Burgoyne Valley near Fulford.

entities.name: Fulford Pickleball Court Project
entities.description: Proposed development of up to eight new pickleball courts near Fulford.
entities.quote: the LCC had advanced the Fulford Pickleball Court Project on district-owned land adjacent to Fire Hall No. 2

entities.name: Burgoyne Valley
entities.description: Bucolic valley on Salt Spring Island where the courts are planned.
entities.quote: in the bucolic Burgoyne Valley near Fulford.

entities.name: Fulford
entities.description: Area on Salt Spring Island adjacent to the proposed courts.
entities.quote: in the bucolic Burgoyne Valley near Fulford.

entities.name: Salt Spring Island Fire Protection District
entities.description: Fire protection district whose trustees were surprised by the pickleball project.
entities.quote: trustees for the Salt Spring Island Fire Protection District (SSIFPD) seemed mostly surprised that the LCC had advanced the Fulford Pickleball Court Project

entities.name: Fire Hall No. 2
entities.description: Fire hall on district‑owned land adjacent to the proposed pickleball site.
entities.quote: on district-owned land adjacent to Fire Hall No. 2

entities.name: Rollie Cook
entities.description: Board chair of the SSIFPD who fielded calls from nearby landowners.
entities.quote: SSIFPD board chair Rollie Cook said he had fielded phone calls from nearby landowners who were “not happy” about existing pickleball play at the site

entities.name: Jamie Holmes
entities.description: Fire Chief who said housing and pickleball courts would be incompatible.
entities.quote: Fire Chief Jamie Holmes indicated the two uses would likely be incompatible

entities.name: Brad Hefferon
entities.description: Adjacent property owner who wrote a letter to the Driftwood criticizing the proposal.
entities.quote: Immediately-adjacent property owner Brad Hefferon, in a July 15 letter to the Driftwood, lamented learning of the proposal from the newspaper rather than from staff or members of the LCC themselves

entities.name: Driftwood
entities.description: Local newspaper that received Brad Hefferon’s letter.
entities.quote: in a July 15 letter to the Driftwood

entities.name: Robin Williams
entities.description: SSIFPD board member who said he was shocked by the project.
entities.quote: “I was really quite shocked,” said SSIFPD board member Robin Williams Monday night

entities.name: Rodney Dieleman
entities.description: Chief administrative officer who suggested the LCC was trying to gauge public opinion.
entities.quote: chief administrative officer Rodney Dieleman suggested the LCC might’ve been trying to “feel the public out

entities.name: Gary Holman
entities.description: CRD director who noted that public engagement on the project was still forthcoming.
entities.quote: Salt Spring Capital Regional District director Gary Holman noted in a Facebook post that public engagement on the Fulford Pickleball Court Project was still forthcoming

entities.name: Islands Trust
entities.description: Regional trust that must approve rezoning for the project.
entities.quote: and a rezoning process through the Islands Trust

entities.name: Rainbow Road Recreation Area Master Plan
entities.description: Master plan that would need an amendment to accommodate the new courts.
entities.quote: would require an amendment to the Rainbow Road Recreation Area Master Plan

entities.name: Rainbow Road
entities.description: Road where a synthetic ice rink is being planned.
entities.quote: LCC is advancing plans to situate a recently-donated synthetic ice rink at Rainbow Road.

entities.name: Synthetic ice rink
entities.description: Donated ice rink that LCC plans to place at Rainbow Road.
entities.quote: LCC is advancing plans to situate a recently-donated synthetic ice rink at Rainbow Road.

entities.name: Portlock Park
entities.description: Former site from which pickleball was conceptually shifted to Rainbow Road.
entities.quote: conceptually shifted pickleball from Portlock Park to Rainbow Road.

entities.description: Land designation that the proposed site falls within, requiring a non‑farm use application.
entities.quote: as the proposed site lies within the Agricultural Land Reserve

source.title: Long-awaited road repairs underway - Salt Spring Island news

entities.name: Broadwell Road
entities.description: A road on Salt Spring Island that has been closed to traffic since December 2025 for culvert repairs.
entities.quote: Broadwell Road has been closed to traffic since December 2025, after a routine inspection discovered debris hung up in the culvert...

entities.name: Sunset Drive
entities.description: A road on Salt Spring Island that has been operating as a single‑lane “take turns” route after a culvert failure.
entities.quote: Sunset Drive has been a “take turns” single lane since that culvert failure.

entities.name: Blackburn Road
entities.description: A road on Salt Spring Island where crews are replacing an oversized culvert near Sunrise Place.
entities.quote: Emcon Services’ South Island operations manager Andrew Gaetz confirmed on July 22 that crews had already begun work at Blackburn Road near Sunrise Place...

entities.name: Duck Creek
entities.description: A fish‑bearing creek on Salt Spring Island where fish exclusion dams were installed for the road works.
entities.quote: Fish exclusion dams were installed in Duck Creek on both sides of Broadwell Road on Thursday...

entities.name: Duck Creek Park
entities.description: A park adjacent to Sunset Drive where concrete barriers were placed around a washed‑out section of the road.
entities.quote: Concrete barriers route traffic around the washed-out side of Sunset Drive at its lowest point next to Duck Creek Park.

entities.name: North Salt Spring Waterworks District
entities.description: The local water utility that completed valve installation on the critical water line on Broadwell Road.
entities.quote: The North Salt Spring Waterworks District were completing that work, which finished Friday.

entities.name: Ministry of Transportation and Transit

entities.quote: Ministry of Transportation and Transit roads area manager Owen Page said a critical water line on Broadwell Road needed new valves installed...
